scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/shared && npm run dev -w @waypoint-ai/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/shared && npm run dev -w @waypoint-ai/frontend
scripts.build: npm run contracts:types && npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/shared && npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/backend && npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:types && npm run build -w @waypoint-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @waypoint-ai/backend && npm run typecheck -w @waypoint-ai/frontend
